info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Warehouse Inventory Stocks-v2-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Stocks API provides users with the ability to access and retrieve detailed information regarding stock levels in various warehouses. This endpoint is essential for inventory management, allowing businesses to keep track of their available resources across multiple locations. Typical consumers include supply chain managers and logistics personnel who need to monitor stock availability to ensure efficient operations. By using this API, organizations can enhance their inventory oversight, minimize stockouts, and optimize replenishment strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current stock levels for inventory items. It returns the available quantity and any relevant details regarding the products in the inventory.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the current stock inventory. Ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema to successfully fetch the inventory details.

200.description: Successful retrieval of stock inventory data.
